```{r, warning=F, message=F}

library(clusterProfiler)
library(msigdbr)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(enrichplot)
library(stringr)


# 9.1. Import data


results_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/results"

res_df <- read.csv(
  file.path(results_dir, "DA_results_proteomics.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = F
)






# 9.2. Create ranked protein list


protein_ranks <- res_df$log2FoldChange
names(protein_ranks) <- res_df$gene
protein_ranks <- sort(protein_ranks, decreasing = T)






# 9.3. Hallmark GSEA


hallmark_sets <- msigdbr(
  species = "Homo sapiens",
  category = "H"
) %>%
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol)

set.seed(8634782)

gsea_hallmark_prot <- GSEA(
  geneList = protein_ranks,
  TERM2GENE = hallmark_sets,
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  eps = 0,
  verbose = FALSE
)

hallmark_df_prot <- as.data.frame(gsea_hallmark_prot)

write.csv(
  hallmark_df_prot,
  file.path(results_dir, "GSEA_Hallmark_proteome.csv"),
  row.names = F
)






# 9.4. Reactome GSEA


reactome_sets <- msigdbr(
  species = "Homo sapiens",
  category = "C2",
  subcategory = "CP:REACTOME"
) %>%
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol)

set.seed(8634782)

gsea_reactome_prot <- GSEA(
  geneList = protein_ranks,
  TERM2GENE = reactome_sets,
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  eps = 0,
  verbose = FALSE
)

reactome_df_prot <- as.data.frame(gsea_reactome_prot)

write.csv(
  reactome_df_prot,
  file.path(results_dir, "GSEA_Reactome_proteome.csv"),
  row.names = F
)






# 9.5. Hallmark pathway plots


# View top Hallmark pathways by NES
gsea_hallmark_prot@result %>%
  filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(NES))) %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, Description, NES, p.adjust) %>%
  head(10)


# IFN-gamma
p_ifng_prot <- gseaplot2(
  gsea_hallmark_prot,
  geneSetID = "HALLMARK_INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE",
  title = "Protein Hallmark IFNγ Response",
  base_size = 12,
  subplots = c(1, 2, 3)
)


# IFN-alpha
p_ifna_prot <- gseaplot2(
  gsea_hallmark_prot,
  geneSetID = "HALLMARK_INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE",
  title = "Protein Hallmark IFNα Response",
  base_size = 12,
  subplots = c(1, 2, 3)
)


# Display plots
p_ifng_prot
p_ifna_prot


# Save plots
ggsave(
  file.path(results_dir, "GSEA_IFNG_protein.pdf"),
  p_ifng_prot,
  width = 7,
  height = 6
)

ggsave(
  file.path(results_dir, "GSEA_IFNA_protein.pdf"),
  p_ifna_prot,
  width = 7,
  height = 6
)






# 9.6. Reactome pathway plot


# View top Reactome pathways
gsea_reactome_prot@result %>%
  filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(NES))) %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, Description, NES, p.adjust) %>%
  head(10)


p_reactome_digest_prot <- gseaplot2(
  gsea_reactome_prot,
  geneSetID = "REACTOME_DIGESTION",
  title = "Protein Reactome: Digestion",
  base_size = 12,
  subplots = c(1, 2, 3)
)


# Display plot
p_reactome_digest_prot


# Save plot
ggsave(
  file.path(results_dir, "GSEA_Reactome_Digestion_protein.pdf"),
  p_reactome_digest_prot,
  width = 7,
  height = 6
)






# 9.7. GSEA summary dot-plot function


make_gsea_summary_plot <- function(
    gsea_result,
    prefix,
    top_n = 8,
    wrap_width = 20,
    x_limits = c(-2, 4),
    y_text_size = 9) {
  
  plot_df <- gsea_result@result %>%
    filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(
      Direction = ifelse(NES > 0, "Up", "Down")
    )
  
  top_up <- plot_df %>%
    filter(NES > 0) %>%
    arrange(desc(NES)) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n)
  
  top_down <- plot_df %>%
    filter(NES < 0) %>%
    arrange(NES) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n)
  
  top_pathways <- bind_rows(top_up, top_down) %>%
    mutate(
      Description = gsub(
        paste0("^", prefix),
        "",
        Description
      ),
      Description = gsub("_", " ", Description),
      Description = str_wrap(
        Description,
        width = wrap_width
      ),
      Description = factor(
        Description,
        levels = Description[order(NES)]
      )
    )
  
  ggplot(
    top_pathways,
    aes(y = Description, x = NES)
  ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linewidth = 0.8,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(
        x = 0,
        xend = NES,
        yend = Description
      ),
      linewidth = 0.7,
      color = "grey50"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = Direction),
      shape = 21,
      size = 5,
      color = "black",
      stroke = 1.6
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Up" = "#D55E00",
        "Down" = "#8B4789"
      ),
      breaks = c("Up", "Down"),
      labels = c(
        "Up" = "Upregulated in Definite LRTI",
        "Down" = "Downregulated in Definite LRTI"
      ),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(
      base_size = 14,
      base_family = "Helvetica"
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.justification = "center",
      legend.text = element_text(
        size = 11,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.key.size = unit(1.4, "lines"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = y_text_size,
        face = "bold",
        color = "black"
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 11,
        face = "bold",
        color = "black"
      ),
      axis.title.x = element_text(
        size = 12,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold",
        size = 14
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = 10,
        color = "grey30"
      ),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(
        t = 10,
        r = 60,
        b = 10,
        l = 10
      ),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(
        color = "grey92",
        linewidth = 0.4
      )
    )
}






# 9.8. Hallmark GSEA summary dot plot


p_hallmark_all_prot <- make_gsea_summary_plot(
  gsea_result = gsea_hallmark_prot,
  prefix = "HALLMARK_",
  top_n = 8,
  wrap_width = 20,
  x_limits = c(-2, 4),
  y_text_size = 9
) +
  labs(
    title = "Hallmark Pathway Enrichment (Protein GSEA)",
    subtitle = "Top significant Hallmark pathways",
    x = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  xlim(-2, 4)


# Display plot
p_hallmark_all_prot


# Save plot
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    results_dir,
    "GSEA_Hallmark_protein.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_hallmark_all_prot,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  device = "pdf",
  useDingbats = FALSE
)






# 9.9. Reactome GSEA summary dot plot


p_reactome_top16_prot <- make_gsea_summary_plot(
  gsea_result = gsea_reactome_prot,
  prefix = "REACTOME_",
  top_n = 8,
  wrap_width = 40,
  x_limits = c(-3, 4),
  y_text_size = 8
) +
  labs(
    title = "Reactome Pathway Enrichment (Protein GSEA)",
    subtitle = "Top Up & Down significant Reactome pathways",
    x = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  xlim(-3, 4)


# Display plot
p_reactome_top16_prot


# Save plot
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    results_dir,
    "GSEA_Reactome_protein.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_reactome_top16_prot,
  width = 8,
  height = 8,
  device = "pdf",
  useDingbats = FALSE
)
```
